population.selection: All original sealed FIT source groups in source_roles, roles mean_role or pair_role, and all their cached full_collection frames. No new outcome/source/score selection; zero-support sources remain. The 405 FIT plan allocations include two uncollected videos 1720/1974 whose source groups are absent from original source_roles; report those explicitly but do not add them to the 341 sealed source groups. Every actually cached selected source must belong to the original sealed FIT roles.

resource_bounds.score_access: npy memmap per video/lag, per frame-pair reads/writes only

candidate_set: Every retained query row x every retained row in the exact previous sampled-step lag 1 or 4 frame. Preserve empty/missing-prefix receipts, unknown and released id=-1; no nearest-nonempty fallback. Candidate selection is GT-free. No ego compensation. Original-frame time gaps, not sampled-step seconds.
history: Released ID is only a past-history locator. Nonnegative same-ID duplicates have no current CV and invalidate the next unique history; id=-1 has no history. Keep explicit reason/mask/history coordinates in each video row metadata.
seal: All GT-free scores, complete row/frame mapping and frame-pair receipts are globally SHA-sealed before importing any supervised helper or opening supervised identity payload. Then verify every shard/rowmap/receipt hash again before legal join.
identity_join: Only audited eligible FIT manual identity fields via immutable observation index (image_id,dump_row). Skip tune before identity projection. No class-heldout target table or GT category/error/soft_risk/posterior_argmax is decoded. All retained candidates include unknown or heldout objects as unknown; unknown is never negative. No-positive in the known subset means missing eligible identity coverage, not a certified unmatched/null target; unknown refs may be the true same identity. Report no-positive coverage only, never generate no-match training labels.
reports: Every source/role/dataset block, both fixed lags, all-candidate and same cached predicted-category scopes, all-known and common CV-valid masks. Exact known p/n/unknown, GT-trajectory support, CV/history missing, top1 tie lowest immutable dump_row; all nonempty-known and p+n query subsets, paired rawcos repair/break, per-GT/source error concentration, same-query cross-lag support and every source-held-out fold. Sparse-known conditional ranking only; no deployed full-candidate or assignment claim.
support_gate: Necessary logical conditions only: at least two source groups with hard same-predcat CV query, at least two with raw-error query, cross-lag shared hard query, and at least one source-held-out fold with positive/negative hard-query training and evaluation support in BOTH fixed lags. Failures reported as blockers; status always HOLD_PENDING_SEPARATE_TRAINING_PROTOCOL, no automatic training approval or source selection.
forbidden: No training, fitting weights, hyperparameter search, source/query/lag selection, threshold sweep, five-mode rescue, tune/test/heldout correctness, tracker/network/cache modification, GPU or new literature work.
